payload.comment: Prior-art stage is internally consistent and properly gated. Data profile (PathMNIST, 9-class, 28×28 RGB, train=89996/val=10004/test=7180, imbalance ≈1.63) matches the official MedMNIST distribution with no subsampling, no duplicates, no blank images. The three literature sources (ViT, Compact Transformers, MedMNIST v2) are all curated excerpts retrieved from cache; the deterministic finding correctly flags that these are not live retrieval evidence, which limits the strength of the prior-art grounding but does not invalidate the hypotheses derived from them. The four ideas are traceable to their cited quotes and the two proposals are self-consistent: the compact_conv_stem_transformer spec (3×3 conv stride 4 → 7×7×64 → 49 tokens, 2 encoder layers, 4 heads × head_dim 16, FFN 128, GAP → 64-dim → 9-class head) is dimensionally coherent and the training recipe is reasonable for ~90k samples. The tissue_geometric_aug proposal (hflip, vflip) is redundant because these are built-in augmentations that do not require extension approval per pipeline rules; its pending_review status does not block use of the primitives. Minor note: the idea 'conv_tokenization_compact' references stride 7 while the authoritative proposal uses stride 4; the proposal is the binding specification and the idea remains a hypothesis_to_validate, so this is not a conflict. LLM model digest is null for qwen3.8 (reproducibility note, non-blocking). No critical or blocking issues identified. Proceed to next stage.
